messages.subject: error for region counts Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)
parts:
Dear discussion group,

 

I have 4 single nucleotide resolution files that I have read in and generated a single methylRawList object (myobj).

I then used the unite function in order to obtain a methyBase object containing all CG that are in common in all 4 files:

meth=unite(myobj, destrand=FALSE)

 

I then extracted the data from the resulting methylBase object for all 4 files to make a data frame:

 

getD=getData(meth)

A1<-getD[,c("chr","start","end","strand","coverage1","numCs1","numTs1")]

S1<-getD[,c("chr","start","end","strand","coverage2","numCs2","numTs2")]

A2<-getD[,c("chr","start","end","strand","coverage3","numCs3","numTs3")]

S2<-getD[,c("chr","start","end","strand","coverage4","numCs4","numTs4")]

 

And made two new methylRawLists:

myobj1=new("methylRawList",list(A1,S1),treatment=c(0,1))

myobj2=new("methylRawList",list(A2,S2),treatment=c(0,1))

 

I then saved the objects, and re-loaded on another day in a new session.

save(myobj1,myobj2, file="myobj1.myobj2.RData")

 

New session:

load("myobj1.myobj2.RData")

They are in the space and seem to be fine and is a big file:

> class(myobj1)

[1] "methylRawList"

attr(,"package")

[1] "methylKit"

> nrow(myobj1[[1]])

[1] 45117635

 

Then I wanted to region counts, so I first loaded the bed files and then attempted region counts with an error:

gene500.obj=read.transcript.features("/home/mdj30/reference/hg19.EnsemblGenes.bed",up.flank=500,down.flank=100)

and it is fine and there:

> class(gene500.obj)

[1] "GRangesList"

attr(,"package")

[1] "GenomicRanges"

Tss500ox=regionCounts(myobj1,gene500.obj$promoters,cov.bases=0,strand.aware=TRUE)

Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  :

  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘regionCounts’ for signature ‘"data.frame", "GRanges"’

 

I really don’t understand why I have the error, I have used the same bed file for other analyses with no errors, it seems to be specifically related to these particular methylRawLists.

In addition to this I have previously used the new methylRawList function after doing adjustmethylC , and doing the region counts without any errors.

 

It seems to be something specific to the fact I made a data frame then made a methylRawList, but I can’t figure out why?

 

Have I made some error in making a data frame then converting it into a methylRawList?

parts:
Hi Michelle,

The problem seems to be in the way you have recreated the methylRawList objects using the function new(). I am not sure how perfect the new() function will recreate a methylRawList object.

I would reconsider the way to move forward
  • I would use the methylKit function reorganize() either on "methylRawList" or "methylBase" object. This function would create an object that is a subset of the object from the above classes (not the function new())
    • myobj2=reorganize(any_methylkit.obj,sample.ids =c("one","two"),treatment = c(0,1) )
  • The object created by new() somehow is more like a dataframe rather than "methylRawList" object (I dont know why the  myobj1 created from new() function still shows as "methylRawList")

I am sure you will be able to work your way through!


Regards,
Kalyan

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] error for region counts Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)
parts:
You should create the methylRawList with methylRaw objects. You are creating it with data frames, this should return an error. I noted this to be fixed.
https://trello.com/c/wlY2Cal2/57-validity-check-for-methylrawlist-during-setclass-it-should-check-list-have-methylraw-elements

But you don't need to re-create a methylRawList to run regionCounts(), it should work on methylBase object, this is partially documented in the help page.
so if you run regionCounts(meth,gene500.obj$promoters,cov.bases=0,strand.aware=TRUE), it should work.
